title: Implement a Feign Client call to another microservice with a custom error decoder that translates downstream errors
hint: Declare a @FeignClient interface and implement ErrorDecoder, switching on response.status() to return custom exceptions, registered as a bean in the client config.

title: Wrap a Feign/REST call with a Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j) including a fallback method
hint: Annotate the call with @CircuitBreaker(name, fallbackMethod) from Resilience4j, with a fallback method of the same signature plus a Throwable parameter.

title: Implement the Outbox pattern — write a business change and an outbox event in the same local transaction, then publish it via a separate poller
hint: Save the entity and an outbox event row in one @Transactional method, then a scheduled poller reads unpublished events, publishes them and marks them processed.

title: Implement a simple Saga (choreography-based) across two services for an order-and-payment flow, including compensating actions on failure
hint: Each service publishes events (OrderCreated, PaymentFailed) and listens to the other's; on failure publish a compensating event that cancels the order.

title: Implement a distributed lock with Redis (SET NX PX) and safe release using a Lua script
hint: Acquire with SET key value NX PX ttl using a unique token, and release with a Lua script that deletes the key only if the stored value matches.

title: Implement a rate-limiting filter at the gateway using a Redis-backed token bucket
hint: Use a Lua script in Redis to refill and decrement tokens atomically per client key, called from a gateway filter, returning 429 when empty.

title: Configure Resilience4j (retry, circuit breaker, time limiter) with proper ordering and a fallback, and test the behavior
hint: Configure Retry, CircuitBreaker and TimeLimiter instances in properties; the aspect order is Retry then CircuitBreaker then RateLimiter then TimeLimiter then Bulkhead, and test with a failing stub.
